pages.text: Cinderglee is a flame that burns with the very essence of Risus and can be created by setting Remains on fire. Though, saying that it 'burns' is not entirely correct. It does not burn physical matter for fuel. The only thing it can burn is the 'existence' of creatures. Whenever one steps in it, they experience Existential Burn, that in practice, greatly decreases their potential to stay alive.

The fact that it cannot burn physical matter also means that a Cinderglee Campfire cannot actually cook anything, nor release signal smoke. Existential Burn can also not be put out with Water or any other liquid.
